gaps.source_claim: 丑来天梁，见太阴化科，则天机必同时化忌，主因财受谤。未宫者尤甚。故得财亦不宜张扬。
gaps.reason: The original scan literally reads 丑来天梁 although the preceding clause reads 丑未天梁. The phrase may be a source/printing issue; context alone does not authorize correction.
gaps.resolution_requirements: Resolve only against an authoritative alternate edition or explicit source-owner decision. Do not normalize to 丑宫天梁 or 丑未天梁, and do not promote the dependent rule while the branch wording remains unresolved.
